about: Attorney Alexandre Ballerini is the managing partner of Ballerini Law, headquartered in Miami Beach, Florida, with a presence in New York, Paris, and Rome. A top-rated Real Estate & Business lawyer. Mr. Ballerini provides counseling and support to a diverse range of clients throughout South Florida, New York, and D.C. as well as internationally, who have legal needs involving any of the following:

Along with his legal degree, Mr. Ballerini also holds a Master of Business Administration, and he has extensive business and real estate experience.. He has worked with a broad range of clients, including technology startups, venture capitalists, banking and financial institutions, real estate finance and development clients, and many others.

Outside his legal practice, Mr. Ballerini has served as vice president for a major real estate brokerage firm and real estate developer ranked top 20 nationwide, where he oversaw multibillion-dollar real estate portfolios. He also has extensive experience handling high-stakes, multimillion-dollar real estate transactions along with international mergers & acquisitions, international tax matters, and other areas.
A multilingual attorney, Alexandre also speaks French, Italian, and Spanish fluently.

Mr. Ballerini received his French baccalaureate cum laude in 1990, and he has studied at the American Business School of Paris. In 1993, he graduated from the University of Hartford, where he obtained his Bachelor's degree in Business administration. In 1996, after one year at Bryant University, he obtained his Master of Business Administration from the University of Hartford. In 2008, he completed the executive program "Corporate Finance for Senior Executives" at Harvard Business School. In 2012, he received his Juris Doctor from St. Thomas University School of Law where he was placed on the Dean's list in 2011 and 2012.
Alexandre is admitted to practice law in Florida, the District of Columbia, and New York.
